item.description: A Missouri mother and another caretaker have been charged with murder in the death of her emaciated 3-year-old son, who died from cancer in a squalid, roach-infested home two years after doctors found a tumor on his adrenal gland that his guardians ignored, according to police.

media:content.media:text: The exterior of a hospital building.
media:content.media:description: The child had been diagnosed with a neuroblastoma at Children’s Mercy Hospital in Kansas City but was never taken back for the follow-ups that doctors recommended.

item.title: Missouri mom charged with murder after police say 3-year-old died of untreated cancer
